scope: Actual Railway terrain and scenery, synthetic accepted twenty-actor snapshots and defeat facts; no physics or physical radio timing
timing: Draw includes nested actor/effect updates and GL submission. Accepted input measures setCombatActors, observeCombat, and periodic archive/restore. Presentation frame is their per-frame sum; fixture generation, terrain streaming, and prewarm excluded.
